app.name: BitPerfect
app.tagline: Convert your audio without it leaving the browser.
app.description: Pick a file, pick a format, download it. Conversion runs on your machine: nothing is uploaded, there are no accounts, and no history is kept.

multiThread.label: Multi-thread
multiThread.help: Your browser allows SharedArrayBuffer, so conversion is spread across {{threads}} cores.

singleThread.label: Single-thread
singleThread.help: Your browser does not allow SharedArrayBuffer. Conversion runs on one thread and takes longer, but the result is identical.

dropzone.title: Drop an audio file
dropzone.subtitle: or click to choose one
dropzone.limit: Up to {{size}} MB · MP3 · AAC · OGG · OPUS · FLAC · WAV · ALAC · AIFF

reject.not-audio: “{{name}}” does not look like an audio file.

format.losslessHint: keeps every bit of the original
format.lossyHint: drops information to take up less space

preset.customActive: You have changed a setting by hand. Pick a preset again to restore it.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.help: Good sound at a reasonable size.

bitrate.label: Bitrate
bitrate.help: Data per second of audio. Higher means better quality and a bigger file.
bitrate.notApplicable: {{format}} has no bitrate: it discards nothing, so the audio itself sets the size.

sampleRate.label: Sample rate
sampleRate.help: Samples per second. 44.1 kHz is CD quality; raising it will not improve a lower-rate original.

bitDepth.label: Bit depth
bitDepth.help: Bits per sample. More depth means more dynamic range.
bitDepth.notApplicable: {{format}} does not expose bit depth: the codec handles it internally.

channels.label: Channels
channels.help: Mono halves the size; stereo keeps the separation between left and right.

flac.label: FLAC compression
flac.help: Does not affect quality: FLAC is lossless and every level sounds identical. 0 converts fast and takes slightly more space; 8 converts slowly and takes slightly less.

metadata.label: Keep metadata
metadata.help: Title, artist, album, year and track number carry over to the converted file.

cover.label: Keep cover art
cover.help: The embedded image carries over to the converted file.
cover.notSupported: {{format}} does not support embedded cover art when ffmpeg writes it.

upconversion.title: Going lossless does not recover quality
upconversion.body: The original already lost information when it was compressed, and that does not come back. You get a faithful copy of what is there, taking up considerably more space.

lossyToLossy.title: Re-encoding degrades the sound again
lossyToLossy.body: The source is already a lossy format. Converting it to another one stacks two compressions, and raising the bitrate does not prevent that.

upsampling.title: A higher sample rate adds no detail
upsampling.body: The original does not contain that information. The file grows without sounding better.

bitDepthUpscale.title: More bit depth adds no range
bitDepthUpscale.body: The extra bits are padded with zeros. The file grows and gains nothing.

noCoverSupport.title: The cover art will be lost
noCoverSupport.body: The chosen format does not take an embedded image when ffmpeg writes it. Other metadata is still preserved.

footer.privacy: Everything happens in your browser. No file is ever sent to a server.
